summary.zh: Snowflake股价周四上涨36%，创下历史新高，此前公司提高了业绩指引，并宣布与亚马逊达成AI计算协议。

title.zh: 消息称五角大楼寻求与美国无人机公司达成融资协议，可能涉及股权投资
title.en: Sources: the Pentagon is pursuing funding deals with US drone companies, potentially with equity stakes, to increase domestic production and lower weapon costs

summary.zh: 消息人士透露，五角大楼正在寻求与美国无人机公司达成融资协议，可能涉及股权投资，以增加国内生产并降低武器成本。

title.zh: 伦敦超越巴黎，重回欧洲领先科技中心地位，2025年融资达177亿美元
title.en: Dealroom: London overtakes Paris to reclaim its position as Europe's leading tech hub, and now ranks fourth globally; London startups raised $17.7B in 2025

summary.zh: 根据Dealroom数据，伦敦超越巴黎，重新成为欧洲领先的科技中心，并在全球排名第四。伦敦初创公司在2025年共筹集了177亿美元资金。
summary.en: Dealroom reports London has overtaken Paris as Europe's leading tech hub, ranking fourth globally, with $17.7B raised by London startups in 2025.

title.zh: 美国AI热潮吸走风险投资，非洲初创企业转向本地资金来源
title.en: As the US AI boom drains venture capital from Africa, startups on the continent are pivoting to domestic funding sources, like pension funds and local VC firms

summary.zh: 随着美国AI热潮吸引了大量风险投资，非洲的初创企业开始转向本地资金来源，如养老金和本地风投公司。
summary.en: As the US AI boom attracts venture capital, African startups are turning to local funding sources like pension funds and local VCs.

title.zh: Cognition融资超10亿美元，推动AI软件工程师Devin扩展
title.en: More Devins in More Places (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Cognition以260亿美元估值融资超10亿美元，支持其AI软件工程师Devin的扩展。Devin显著缩短了项目时间并提升了客户的自动化能力。
summary.en: Cognition raised over $1B at a $26B valuation to expand Devin, an AI software engineer that improves automation and reduces project times.

title.zh: ElevenLabs发布音乐生成模型Music v2
title.en: ElevenLabs Music Generation Model (3 minute read)

summary.zh: ElevenLabs发布了Music v2，这是一款能够在单曲中切换音乐风格，同时保持人声和作曲连贯性的音乐生成模型。
summary.en: ElevenLabs released Music v2, a music-generation model capable of switching genres mid-track while maintaining coherence.

title.zh: Biohub发布全球蛋白质生物学模型
title.en: Biohub releases a world model of protein biology (9 minute read)

summary.zh: Biohub发布了一个开放的蛋白质结构预测和生物学发现引擎，包括ESMC语言模型、ESMFold2设计引擎和ESM Atlas，供全球科学界免费使用。
summary.en: Biohub released an open discovery engine for protein biology, including ESMC, ESMFold2, and ESM Atlas, all freely available.

title.zh: Anthropic和OpenAI找到产品市场契合点
title.en: I think Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit (11 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic和OpenAI开始积极定价其API，表明其编码和通用代理产品已找到市场契合点，企业每用户月支出超过200美元。
summary.en: Anthropic and OpenAI have likely found product-market fit with their coding/general-purpose agent products, leading to aggressive API pricing.

title.zh: 使用Codex构建自我改进的税务代理
title.en: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex (17 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI使用Codex在Thrive Holdings构建了能够自我改进的税务代理，能够处理日益复杂的税务申报。
summary.en: OpenAI used Codex to build self-improving tax agents at Thrive Holdings, capable of handling increasingly complex tax returns.

title.zh: 通过Hub Bucket传输万亿参数：TRL中的Delta Weight Sync
title.en: Shipping a Trillion Parameters With a Hub Bucket: Delta Weight Sync in TRL (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 介绍了一种在异步强化学习中减少权重同步负载的方法“Delta Weight Sync”，通过仅传输更改的模型参数显著减少数据传输量。
summary.en: A method called 'Delta Weight Sync' reduces weight synchronization payload in async RL by transmitting only changed parameters.

title.zh: 安全MCP隧道
title.en: Secure MCP Tunnel (6 minute read)

summary.en: Secure MCP Tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI products while maintaining server privacy and secure data flow.

title.zh: LiteParse v2.0发布：本地运行的高效PDF解析工具
title.en: LiteParse v2.0 (1 minute read)

summary.zh: LiteParse是一款独立的开源PDF解析工具，支持高质量的空间文本解析，支持多语言和多平台，完全在本地运行，无需依赖云服务。
summary.en: LiteParse is an OSS PDF parsing tool offering high-quality spatial text parsing locally without cloud dependencies.

title.zh: NVIDIA推出LocateAnything以加速视觉语言锚定
title.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything for Faster Grounding (8 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA推出LocateAnything，这是一种视觉语言锚定框架，可并行解码边界框，从而加快处理速度。
summary.en: NVIDIA's LocateAnything is a vision-language grounding framework that decodes bounding boxes in parallel for faster processing.

title.zh: 推出 Apex：专为 React Native 优化的快速模型
title.en: Introducing Apex: A Fast, Specialized Model for React Native

summary.zh: Apex 是一个专为 React Native 开发的编码模型，能够分析架构决策、修复框架特定问题并推理约束条件。该模型目前处于开发阶段，并已向部分团队开放私测。
summary.en: Apex is a React Native coding model designed to analyze architecture decisions, fix framework-specific issues, and reason about constraints. It is currently in private beta with selected teams.

title.zh: Nvidia 投资 1500 亿美元支持台湾，反击美国 AI 中心计划
title.en: Nvidia bets $150B on Taiwan as Trump's plan to make US an AI hub backfires

summary.zh: Nvidia 将每年投资 1500 亿美元，确保台湾在 AI 革命中的核心地位。该公司计划在台湾建立新总部，加强与 TSMC 的合作，并利用当地先进的封装技术。
summary.en: Nvidia will invest $150 billion annually to solidify Taiwan's position as a tech manufacturing hub, including a new headquarters and partnerships with TSMC.

title.zh: YouTube 扩展自动 AI 视频标注功能
title.en: YouTube Expands Automatic AI Video Labeling

summary.zh: YouTube 宣布将自动为包含显著写实 AI 内容的视频添加标签，以减少对创作者自我披露的依赖。
summary.en: YouTube will automatically label videos with significant photorealistic AI content, reducing reliance on creator self-disclosure.

title.zh: 前 Google 和 Apple 研究员创立 Trajectory，提升 AI 反馈循环
title.en: Former Google and Apple researchers launch Trajectory to enhance AI feedback loops

summary.zh: 一家位于帕洛阿尔托的新创公司 Trajectory 致力于开发能够观察和解释物理世界的 AI 系统。
summary.en: The Palo Alto-based startup Trajectory aims to develop AI systems capable of interpreting the physical world.

title.zh: Google DeepMind 的 Hassabis：AGI 或将在 3 到 4 年内实现
title.en: Google DeepMind's Hassabis: AGI is 3 to 4 years away

summary.zh: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 预测 AGI 将在 2029-2030 年实现，比他之前预测的 2030-2035 年有所提前。
summary.en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis predicts AGI could be achieved by 2029-30, earlier than his previous estimate of 2030-2035.

title.zh: Google 为 Gemini for Business 推出可共享项目功能
title.en: Google expands Gemini for Business with shareable Projects

summary.zh: Google 为 Gemini for Business 增加了可共享项目功能，允许团队成员在专用的多界面工作空间中协作。
summary.en: Google enhances Gemini for Business with shareable Projects, enabling team collaboration in dedicated multi-surface workspaces.

title.zh: Anthropic 将扩展 Claude 的语音模式至更多语言
title.en: Anthropic to expand Claude Voice Mode to more languages

summary.zh: Anthropic 计划将 Claude 的语音模式扩展到 18 种新语言。
